title: Add failing test for composing default class
author: mrginglymus
summary: `composes: default` is silently ignored because the class name is parsed with CustomIdent, which rejects CSS-wide keywords and `default`; the declaration then falls back to an unparsed `composes:` that leaks into the output. Despite the title, the PR includes the fix: parse a plain ident (still rejecting `from`).
evidence: Master CLI (/home/user/lightningcss/target/review/ref-574eee2/lightningcss (master 574eee2)) `--css-modules`: `.default{color:blue}.foo{composes:default;color:red}` -> JSON `foo.composes: []` and CSS `.WduyGG_foo{composes:default;color:red}`. One-line change in src/properties/css_modules.rs parse_one_ident; also makes `composes: inherit/initial` etc. reference classes of that name (CSS-wide keywords aren't handled generically in Property::parse, so previously they also became unparsed `composes`). Author pinged the maintainer 2025-08-14 with no reply. Nearly trivial; quick review to confirm the keyword behavior is wanted.
